paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved +0.19% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+5.10%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.95%). Brent crude changed -11.85% to 92.35. Gold changed +4.48% to 4,147.2998. Bitcoin changed -6.66% to 75,048.2734. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.864%, a relative move of -0.61%. Among the firms tracked, Gold Miners (ETF) (+15.55%) and Newmont (+14.73%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: Monzo explores fundraising at £7.5bn valuation as private equity talks stall (FT Markets).
